title: Mixed Event — Carnation Recollection — Episode5 Flowers from a Distant Past

meta.Episode: Episode5 — Flowers from a Distant Past
meta.Event Outline: Despite Kanade's persistent efforts to save Mafuyu, none of the songs she composes seem to leave an impression on her. Feeling like she's reached a dead end, Kanade heads to SEKAI for advice...

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, white carnations!
I always see red or pink ones, but these white ones are really pretty too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Do you like carnations, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, uh... Not me...
My mom did...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She always kept some around the house, and I bring her these every time I go visit her grave.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, it's okay.
I'm sorry for asking without really thinking it through first.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But flowers are great, aren't they?
They have this therapeutic quality to them...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It'd be great to even see a whole field of them. One with lavenders and sunflowers... It'd be so beautiful...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A field of flowers...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I vaguely remember my dad taking us to see one a long time ago.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really? Like a field of carnations...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. It was fairly close by too, I think. I remember being surprised by how you could see something like that in the city.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that is pretty surprising!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I remember having so much fun then... The weather was nice and everyone was laughing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Kanade. Wanna try finding that flower field together?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's somewhere around here, right?
There's only a few places in the city where something like that could be, so I'm sure we'll find it pretty quick!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But it's still raining... Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
I've got my favorite rainboots on too, so it'd be nice to get a little more mileage on them!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thanks, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then let's start with... Miyamasuzaka Park. That's been there forever, and it's huge!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. Let's try there.
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Man... We've checked out every park around here, but nothing...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe I'm confusing it with somewhere else. It might not actually be in the city like I said.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm so sorry for making you do this. Especially considering the weather...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Don't worry about that, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Let's just keep looking, alright?
It could still be on the other side of the station, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No it's okay. Let's stop for now.
Thank you for doing this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry I couldn't help you find it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But maybe some other time we can...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But when...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Will I still be friends with her when that time comes...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Uh... N-Nothing. It's nothing.
Something was bugging me is all.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you're heading back to the station, right? We can use this park as a shortcut to get there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This rain really isn't letting up, huh? All we've been getting lately is bad weather too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you might even think of a good song when it's finally sunny again, so I wouldn't fret too much, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And whenever you feel like hanging out again, you know who to call!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right, I'll keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It was nice doing something like this for a change.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really? That's great!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: To tell you the truth, I went to visit my dad today...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Your dad?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ever since he had his breakdown, his memory's become jumbled. He talked about the time before I was born today...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: He seemed so happy too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then it reminded me of how I took away his happiness. I felt so awful afterwards...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That was when I thought that I have to compose a song that can save Mafuyu as soon as I can.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I convinced myself that I had no right to be there unless I did that first...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I feel much better after you took me around to visit all these other places, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Don't mention it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Kanade...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She thinks what happened to her dad is all her fault and is making songs like this as some sort of punishment.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I want to tell her that it's not her fault and she doesn't have to do this...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I doubt that'll make her stop. It probably doesn't matter who tells her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So at the very least...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Um, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You keep saying that you haven't been able to save anyone yet.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I can say for sure that you saved me. At least, the old me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Since I was little, I thought that living life was way too hard and really didn't like it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, around junior high, I convinced myself that everything would be better if I just disappeared.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But that was when I heard one of your songs.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I felt that I'd found someone that was just like me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I felt like trying a little harder after hearing it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, it's letting up!
You think it'll stop soon?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It looks like it.
Everyone else is starting to put away their umbrellas.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yay!
All this rain's really been such a drag...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Speaking of which, there's actually one more spot that I want to show you. Wanna check it out since it's finally stopped raining?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: One more spot...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Sure, I'd like to see it.
What's it like?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's a secret! Well, not really. You can't actually hide a place like this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's that place with the fountain that's just nearby. It has all these little flowerbeds and looks so pretty♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Look, you can sort of see it now!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There? Huh? Wait...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Those flowerbeds. Could it be...?
